snippet.title: Azure Infinity | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mecha × Tactics! 
Azure Infinity is a turn-based tactical Strategy RPG set in a sci‑fi world. 
As an SRT member of the secret mercenary organization Yggdrasill, you will command the huge humanoid weapon RAIV to carry out a range of missions and confront the crisis approaching this world.

Wishlist Azure Infinity on Steam now!

#IndieGame #SRPG #JRPG
